en.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Brings Back Snowboarding, Red XIII Steals the Show
en.summary: The epic conclusion to the Final Fantasy 7 Remake saga, **Final Fantasy 7 Revelation**, is set to feature the return of the beloved snowboarding minigame. Director Naoki Hamaguchi teases that **Red XIII** will have a unique role, promising an unforgettable experience for fans.
en.body:
The highly anticipated **Final Fantasy 7 Revelation**, poised to conclude the groundbreaking remake trilogy, is bringing back one of the most cherished distractions from the original **Final Fantasy VII**: the snowboarding minigame. Set to launch on April 8, 2027, this installment promises not only a climactic narrative but also a wealth of engaging side activities for players to dive into when they're not racing against time to save the planet from **Sephiroth**'s machinations.

The iconic Golden Saucer will once again host this fan-favorite diversion. While details remain somewhat scarce, game director **Naoki Hamaguchi** has acknowledged the significant expectations surrounding its return. He hinted at a surprising twist involving **Red XIII** (Nanaki), suggesting that while all party members will participate, **Red XIII** might not be using a traditional snowboard.

> "I can say that this snowboarding section will be in Revelation, and all of the party members, you'll see them, um, in that snowboarding section. But Nanaki might not be on a snowboard," Hamaguchi stated. "You'll have to like look forward to what he's going to be riding. I think it's going to get a lot of attention."

This playful tease is perfectly in line with **Red XIII**'s memorable appearances in both **Final Fantasy 7 Remake** and **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth**. His attempts to fit in with the bipedal cast, whether by donning a disguise for the **Queen's Blood** tournament or visiting his family, have consistently provided some of the series' most humorous and surprising moments. The prospect of seeing him navigate the slopes in an unconventional manner is sure to generate considerable excitement.

## A Familiar Playground with New Surprises

**Final Fantasy 7 Revelation** is shaping up to be a monumental entry in the series, building on the expansive open-world design introduced in **Rebirth**. The inclusion of the snowboarding minigame, a staple that has evoked fond memories for long-time fans, is a welcome addition. It offers a moment of levity and pure fun amidst the high stakes of the main storyline, allowing players to engage with the world and its characters in more relaxed, yet still engaging, ways. The game is slated for release on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC.

## Red XIII's Reign Continues

The community's anticipation is palpable, especially given **Red XIII**'s breakout performances. His unique perspective and physical characteristics have consistently led to standout moments, and the snowboarding segment is poised to be another prime example. Furthermore, **Red XIII** is also confirmed to be a central figure in the returning **Queen's Blood** card game, facing powerful opponents that promise to elevate the strategic depth of this already beloved minigame. The journey through **Final Fantasy VII Remake** and **Rebirth** is essential preparation for the events that await in **Revelation**.

## What's Next

With a confirmed release date of April 8, 2027, **Final Fantasy 7 Revelation** is on the horizon. Players are encouraged to experience the events of **Final Fantasy VII Remake** and **Final Fantasy VII Rebirth** before diving into the final chapter. Further details about the snowboarding minigame and **Red XIII**'s role are expected to be revealed in subsequent updates.

content_raw: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is aiming to end the remake trilogy with a bang, and alongside the main campaign, there'll be plenty of other activities to tackle when you're not racing to stop Sephiroth from destroying the planet. Snowboarding is one such distraction, as the iconic minigame from the original Final Fantasy 7 is back, and Square Enix is suggesting that something wild could take place in it. An activity that can be accessed at the Golden Saucer, game director Naoki Hamaguchi hasn't gone into too many details about it just yet, but he did tease that Square Enix knows that there are a lot of "high expectations" surrounding it. Especially when Red XIII (Nanaki) takes part in that event. "I can say that this snowboarding section will be in Revelation, and all of the party members, you'll see them, um, in that snowboarding section. But Nanaki might not be on a snowboard," Hamaguchi said to GameSpot. "You'll have to like look forward to what he's going to be riding. I think it's going to get a lot of attention." Red XIII stole the limelight in several scenes throughout Final Fantasy 7 Remake and Rebirth, thanks to moments where he attempted to blend in with the bipedal cast. From donning a disguise to take part in the Queen's Blood tournament to visiting his adopted family in Cosmo Canyon, he's been responsible for some of the biggest laughs and surprises in the series so far.  A new trailer for Final Fantasy 7 Revelation dropped during the recent PlayStation State of Play broadcast, revealing more of the game and its April 2028 release date . GamneSpot also went hands-on with the Final Fantasy 7 Revelation at Gamescom last month, where we got a taste of just how massive the game is going to be with its expanded open-world design.
